Verify exact extracted members and hashes before and after execution.
Start distinct worker processes whose imports resolve only their own SGLang source tree; prohibit shared sys.modules and current-worktree imports.

Record actual imported module paths/hashes, CUDA header dependencies, compiler/container identity and JIT build identity; content-address or separate caches so changed header cannot reuse an incompatible binary.

Use frozen manifest identities instead of legacy git-diff reporting: archives intentionally omit .git and legacy moe_local.py expects a git checkout.
